text:
tasha_csm: Quick sync  NovaGrid dedicated bring-up in 6h. Need final quota, autoscale knobs, short soak plan. Who's available? :wave:

omar_infra: I'll own infra. Proposal: reserve 6x A100(40G), allow autoscale to 9 for bursts. Customer wanted conservative start.

marta_account: Confirmed with customer: they agreed to 6 reserved if we keep week1 delta < 15%. They'll join the enablement call.

felix_sre: Autoscale rules suggestion:
- add +1 when avg GPU util > 70% for 2m
- scale-in -1 when util < 32% for 8m
- cooldown 3m, max 2 ops per 10m

deepa_ml: Load mix: 60% chat (~1k tokens), 25% embeddings, 15% short-gen. Seed set: s3://novagrid/onboard/seeds-v1.txt

tasha_csm: @deepa_ml drop loadgen flags pls. Also need canary plan and fallback.

deepa_ml: loadgen cmd:
```
loadgen --target https://dedicated.redwood/novagrid --qps 130 --duration 3600 \n  --profile mixed --seeds s3://novagrid/onboard/seeds-v1.txt --concurrency 36
```

omar_infra: prewarm plan: populate KV + compile kernels 20m prior. prewarm command:
```
./bin/prewarm --pool novagrid --minutes 20
```

provision-bot: Provision task scheduled: 1829996400  novagrid-dedicated-provision

felix_sre: Canary: 1 instance handles 4% traffic for 8m then 12m ramp to 30% before full. Fallback: route to hosted model if p95 > 2.7s for 3 consecutive mins.

marta_account: I've invited their oncall to the 45min enablement call at T-1h. Will share week1 cost delta after infra posts instance-hour estimate.

omar_infra: I'll post expected instance-hours and estimated burn in 15m and stream perf to #ops-dashboard. Tagging logs customer:novagrid env:dedicated.

deepa_ml: If >3% 429s, reduce qps by 20% and check cache hit rate. Capture samples for evals post-run.

tasha_csm: Final quick check at T-30 for go/no-go. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
